idea-plugin.name: KuaiKuai
idea-plugin.description:
KuaiKuai is a lucky snack charm for Taiwanese programmers and IDE users.
Displays the 乖乖 snack image in a side tool window to bless your code and servers and keep them well-behaved.
This plugin shows an image of the 乖乖 snack in a tool window, hoping your code will run smoothly and stay free of bugs.
這是一個為台灣程式設計師祈求程式正常運作的乖乖插件。
它會在工具視窗中顯示一張乖乖的圖片，希望你的程式碼能夠乖乖地運行，沒有 bug。
